answer: Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. The reveal must open the same forge hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the wander gate. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 47 original texts is the only way to fill 72 aliases; the raven log preserves both halves. That is 24 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
